plugins.changelogTitle:
# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

plugins.prepareCmd: jq --arg v "${nextRelease.version}" '.version = $v' plugins/agent-kit/.claude-plugin/plugin.json > plugins/agent-kit/.claude-plugin/plugin.json.tmp && mv plugins/agent-kit/.claude-plugin/plugin.json.tmp plugins/agent-kit/.claude-plugin/plugin.json && jq --arg v "${nextRelease.version}" '(.plugins[] | select(.name == "agent-kit")) |= (. + {version: $v})' .claude-plugin/marketplace.json > .claude-plugin/marketplace.json.tmp && mv .claude-plugin/marketplace.json.tmp .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
